portals.name: TGRAC Bhunaksha query MapServer
portals.operator: Telangana Remote Sensing Applications Centre, Government of Telangana
portals.observation: Public ArcGIS REST MapServer layer Full Cadastral is polygon geometry, reports WKID 4326 and query support. A point query at the exact WUP location and a native-key attribute query both returned the same parcel polygon.

requests.assessment: MapServer metadata identifies public layers including Full Cadastral and query operations; layer cap 1000.
Full Cadastral polygon layer advertises WGS84 (WKID 4326), maxRecordCount 1000, and query capability.
Exact WUP point intersects one nonempty polygon; native fields identify Annojiguda revenue village, code 1512012, parcel number 92. Same polygon as exact attribute lookup.

The successful composite natural-key filter DMV_Code=1512012 AND Parcel_num=92 AND V_Name=Annojiguda returned one polygon, with the same 27-vertex ring as the exact WUP point query. No object ID is used as identity.

A separate nearby point returned parcel number 93 with the same DMV_Code=1512012 and Annojiguda/Ghatkesar attributes, showing different parcels are distinguished by Parcel_num within this sampled village; this is not a key-stability or uniqueness proof.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: one point-intersecting parcel at WUP Ghatkesar center; sample in Annojiguda village
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: one parcel feature, no completeness or village/city coverage claim

technicalBlocker: Nine app cells yielded 37 nonblank survey numbers; fresh exact native-ID counts, manifests and geometries timed out at 15 seconds. The source also supports ESRI JSON/AMF only, while the current adapter requires GeoJSON. Three blank-ID Road/Village boundary rows are an explicit omitted-subset candidate, not parcel identities.
remainingUncertainty: Only one parcel was sampled. Attribute identity is composite (DMV_Code 1512012 + Parcel_num 92), but source did not document a permanence guarantee. Not yet an integration acceptance result.
nextStep: Establish repeatable complete native-ID reads within the existing deadline, then add tested ESRI JSON support before app enablement; retain explicit unidentified-boundary exclusions.
